scenes.narration: Four AI reviewers read your manuscript the way a journal panel would, and quote what they question.
Standard is nine dollars, the Journal Pack eleven, Deep Review fifteen.
Each tier checks every reference against CrossRef and scans the figures.
The report lists blind spots, contradictions and a fix checklist, each quoting the passage.
Pay through Stripe, upload the PDF, and read the report in four to eight minutes.
From nine dollars. One-time payment, no subscription.
